events.title: Legend of Azure Peak : Wuxia Heroes - DEMO 1.8 Update Notes
events.summary: Legend of Azure Peak : Wuxia Heroes - DEMO 1.8 Update Notes Adjusted Ao Bing's base stats as some players were consistently getting stuck at this encounter.Reduced the enhancement stone requirement for equipment upgrades from 5 to 3.Increased the success rate of equipment dismantling, making it easier to obtain enhancement stones.Increased the equipment drop rates for elite monsters.Reduced the cost of upgrading lower-tier enhancement stones to higher-tier ones from 5 to 3.
